arrayFormat: At most 128 components: exact JSON values. Otherwise: element count, per-component min/max, SHA-256 of little-endian float32 attributes or uint32 indices. Attributes are stored as float32 after the clause's arithmetic, before mesh registration.
generatedNormalZeros: Generated flat-normal zeros use +0: the specification leaves their zero sign unspecified. Authored float32 bits are retained.
defaults: material.schema.json; material.pbrMetallicRoughness.schema.json; sampler.schema.json; texture.schema.json; node.schema.json at specification revision
samplerEnums: address modes: clamp=0, repeat=1, mirror=2; filters: nearest=0, linear=1
scope: Mapped static fields only; image pixels excluded. Null material denotes the specification's default material; lighting factors omitted for unlit. UV zero is a storage placeholder, not a specification default.

clauses.instances: scenes-overview; nodes-and-hierarchy; geometry-overview; meshes-overview (one record per instantiated primitive; depth-first order is a comparison convention)
clauses.material: meshes-overview; default-material (null denotes no authored material)
clauses.positions: accessors-overview (bufferView undefined: elements initialized with zeros; sparse MAY override); accessor-data-types; sparse-accessors (replacements over base values); meshes-attributes (POSITION)
clauses.uvs: accessors-overview; accessor-data-types; meshes-attributes (TEXCOORD_0); absent UVs use Shallot's zero placeholder
clauses.uv1: accessors-overview; accessor-data-types (normalized unsigned integers); meshes-attributes (TEXCOORD_1); null means absent
clauses.vertexColor: meshes-attributes (COLOR_0, linear RGB/RGBA); meshes-usage (VEC3 alpha is 1); accessor-data-types (normalized unsigned integers); null means absent
clauses.tangent: meshes-attributes (authored TANGENT xyzw, w unchanged); meshes-usage (ignored without NORMAL); null means absent, generated tangents are checked against the separate MikkTSpace reference
clauses.morphWeights: instantiation-morph-targets (node weights override mesh defaults; omitted weights are zero)
clauses.morphTargets: morph-targets-storage (xyz differences, absent semantics are zero); morph-targets-usage (flat target normals from displaced positions; provided tangents ignored without base NORMAL)
clauses.indices: meshes-topology (indexed order; sequential vertices if indices absent); meshes-usage (split corners for flat normals)
clauses.frontFace: instantiation (negative global determinant makes front faces clockwise)
clauses.nodePath: transformations; nodes-and-hierarchy (authored local matrices or TRS, root to instance, for evaluation at the client's float32 storage boundaries)
clauses.textureIndex: material.pbrMetallicRoughness.schema.json (baseColorTexture.index); read from JSON because GLTFLoader's shared texture associations may name the last equivalent texture index
clauses.images: images (uri relative to the glTF asset)
clauses.textureSlots: material.schema.json; textureInfo.schema.json: texture index and texCoord (default 0), read from JSON to preserve texture identity; material.normalTextureInfo.schema.json: scale (default 1); material.occlusionTextureInfo.schema.json: strength (default 1)
clauses.textures: textures (source); samplers (Filtering; Wrapping); absent filters choose linear / linear-mipmap-linear, permitted by Samplers Overview

divergences.reason: GLTFLoader retains provided morph normals or leaves them absent when base normals are implicit; the record recomputes each displaced face.
